description: Source code for handling bulk import of data, including processing JSON lines, managing attachments, and orchestrating worker goroutines for importing posts, channels, users, and other entities in Mattermost.

methods.name: stopOnError
methods.description: Determines whether to stop processing based on specific import error IDs.

methods.name: processAttachmentPaths
methods.description: Validates and processes attachment paths within import data, updating paths and verifying existence in the zip file map.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Processes different types of import lines to handle attachment paths and data, including posts, users, bots, and emojis.

methods.name: bulkImportWorker
methods.description: Worker function that processes import lines in batches, handling posts, direct posts, and other entities, and reporting errors.

methods.name: BulkImport
methods.description: Initiates a bulk import process with default settings.

methods.name: BulkImportWithPath
methods.description: Initiates a bulk import process with specified path and content extraction options.

methods.name: bulkImport
methods.description: Core function that reads JSON lines, manages worker goroutines, processes attachments, and handles import segmentation.

methods.name: processImportDataFileVersionLine
methods.description: Validates the version line in the import data file.

methods.name: importLine
methods.description: Imports individual lines based on their type, such as role, scheme, team, channel, user, bot, direct channel, or emoji.

methods.name: ListImports
methods.description: Lists available import files in the configured directory.

methods.name: DeleteImport
methods.description: Deletes a specified import file from the directory.
